svg.title: One real garden on two different scale drawings
svg.desc: An original 300 by 180 meter rectangular garden has two accurately proportional plan drawings at the same 12 pixels per drawing centimeter. The first drawing is 10 by 6 centimeters at scale 1 centimeter to 30 meters; the second is 15 by 9 centimeters at 1 centimeter to 20 meters. The second drawing has scale factor 1.5 relative to the first plan, and its plan area is 2.25 times larger. The real garden itself does not change size.
svg.text: Same 300 m × 180 m garden, two map scales
New drawing side factor 1.5; drawing-area factor 2.25; land remains unchanged.
